# Bundled font

Vazirmatn variable WOFF2, version 33.0.3, served locally by GitLab Pages.

Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/vazirmatn/v/33.0.3

License: SIL Open Font License 1.1; see LICENSE-Vazirmatn.txt.

The calendar uses the browser's Intl Persian calendar. No third-party JavaScript or external font request is needed at runtime.
